name: DynamoDbCreateOrUpdate
label: Create or Update AWS DynamoDB Item
description: Creates or updates an item in AWS DynamoDB using the PutItem API.

fields.name: AWSServiceVaultId
fields.label: Credential to connect with
fields.description: Select the AWS credential to use for authentication (AWSServiceVaultId).

fields.name: TableName
fields.label: Table Name or ID
fields.description: The name of the DynamoDB table to create or update an item in.

fields.name: DataToSend
fields.label: Data to Send
fields.description: Choose how to send data: auto-map all inputs or define each column manually.

fields.name: InputsToIgnore
fields.label: Inputs to ignore
fields.description: Comma-separated list of input property names to ignore when auto-mapping.

fields.name: FieldsToSend
fields.label: Fields to Send
fields.description: List of fields to send when manually defining columns.

fields.name: AdditionalFields
fields.label: Additional Fields
fields.description: Optional additional fields to include in the item.

fields.name: Region
fields.label: AWS Region
fields.description: The AWS region where the DynamoDB table is located (e.g., us-east-1). Default: us-east-1.

fields.name: Response
fields.label: API Response
fields.description: Raw JSON response from AWS DynamoDB.

fields.name: ItemKey
fields.label: Item Key
fields.description: The primary key of the created/updated item.
